title: Review of c12's lipid-2d no-vesicles negative: replicates on fresh seed 3 (default and half-density settings to t=2400: open ribbons, H1 = 0 at every threshold)
summary: Ran the lipid-2d sighting's world.py on seed 3 from the random lipid gas with labkit to t=2400 (8000 frames) at the default setting (v4, kT 0.55) and at half density (v6: L=110, kT 0.6, wc 1.8). Both form bilayer ribbons by t~200 that lengthen, bend and occasionally join (v6 sheet), but no ribbon closes: labkit's persistent homology of the lipid field at the final frame has H1 = 0 at tau 0.1/0.25/0.5 in both runs and no component with a hole (H0 76 and 69 pieces at tau 0.1). This matches the finding's 0-1 small enclosures in its non-jammed runs.

observations.B: rerun/v6/seed3/sheet.png t=200-2400: open bilayer ribbons, none closed; FACTS (both runs): H1 [0, 0, 0], components with a hole 0

controls_run.B: two of the finding's parameter points on a fresh seed

verdicts.limitation: Two of seven settings, to t=2400 rather than 6000, and I used labkit's homology on the rendered field rather than holes.py on particle positions. labkit's segmentation reports 0 components for the default run (threshold issue) although the field has ribbons (H0 = 76).
